thread:
Priya: incident-bot paged me at 07:02 UTC — Nova Financial (VPC) experienced sharp latency and 5xx spike in chat completions for tenant nova-prod-us1.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — HIGH: nova-prod-us1 error rate > 10% for 3m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-degradation

Oncall-SRE: I'm on. quick summary?

Priya: customer reporting timeouts. Metrics: p95 token latency x3, 5xx ~12% for last 4m, KV-cache miss ratio soared. Seeing model `redwood-open-3b@v2.4` tail latency regressions.

Jordan: Confirming from infra: hosts in dedicated pool `nova-prod-us1` started evicting pods due to OOM on some nodes, but not full pool-wide. Autoscaler attempted to spin up replacements but we hit node quota, so traffic got redistributed to slower fallback instances.

Maya: Customer impact: chat sessions failing intermittently (15% reduction in successful completions), some requests are surprisingly long (30s+). Customer's SLA is 99.9% for latency.

Priya: Ok. Triage plan: 1) Short-term: pin Nova to a safe variant (lower mem & quantized) to stop evictions; 2) Mid-term: increase pool capacity and investigate KV cache thrash root cause; 3) Customer comms — coordinate with AM @Sam (AM).

Sam (AM): I'm here, prepping notification draft. Need ETA for mitigation before comms.

Oncall-SRE: Can we pin to `redwood-open-3b@v2.3-safe`? That variant is already validated for lower memory footprint. If we pin, we should also disable prefix caching for nova tenant temporarily to avoid KV cache storms.

Jordan: We can do a pin at the routing layer. Command: `routectl set-tenant-override --tenant nova --model redwood-open-3b@v2.3-safe --priority override` — this updates routing config. I'll stage it in canary first to 5% of nova traffic.

Maya: Also need a fallback policy so that if the safe variant fails we fallback to `redwood-3b-slim` (a smaller model) rather than trying the bleeding-edge variant.

Priya: Agree. Proposed override matrix: primary=redwood-open-3b@v2.3-safe, safe-fallback=redwood-3b-slim, emergency-fallback=redwood-open-2b-quant. Add KV cache purge on pin.

ops-bot: `/schedule runbook: pin-tenant-model --tenant nova --model redwood-open-3b@v2.3-safe --canary 5% --wait 2m` scheduled by Jordan at 07:10 UTC

Jordan: Executing now. Attaching intended command and config snippet:

```
routectl set-tenant-override --tenant nova --model redwood-open-3b@v2.3-safe --canary 0.05 --apply
cachectl purge --tenant nova --prefixes kv-prefix* --async
policyctl set-fallback --tenant nova --primary redwood-open-3b@v2.3-safe --fallback redwood-3b-slim,redwood-open-2b-quant
```

Priya: :thumbsup: Keep logs and rollback plan handy. Jordan, can you monitor latency, 5xx, and OOMs during canary?

Jordan: Monitoring. I see canary rollout started at 07:12 UTC. First 5% flows now hitting v2.3-safe.

incident-bot: Canary progress: 5% -> 5% after 30s. Metrics snapshot attached.

Maya: Early signals: canary node p95 dropped to normal, 5xx under 1% for canary. Good sign.

Priya: Proceed to ramp to 50% over next 6 minutes if signals stay green. Jordan, incrementally ramp and post updates.

Jordan: Ramp to 20% at 07:16 UTC. Observability: p50/p95 improving, KV-cache miss rate falling. No new OOMs observed on canary hosts.

Sam (AM): I'll tell Nova we have a targeted mitigation in progress and expect improvement within 10-15 minutes. Draft note: "We've applied a temporary model routing change to a validated safe variant; we're monitoring and will follow up with a full postmortem." Thoughts?

Maya: Good. Add note: we may need to purge some long-running KV entries after stabilization.

Priya: Also flag legal/compliance if there's any request for data access — but none so far. Sam, hold on to comms until we hit 50% ramp and confirm.

Jordan: Ramp at 07:19 UTC to 50%. Metrics: global 5xx dropped to 3.2%, p95 latency trending down. OOM event rate decreased by 90% on affected hosts.

Oncall-SRE: Good. Start rolling the override to 100% with 1m observation windows. If anything looks off revert to original via `routectl rollback --tenant nova --to-default`.

ops-bot: Rollout step: 50% -> 75% at 07:21 UTC (automated).

Jordan: Now 100% at 07:23 UTC. All traffic for nova-prod-us1 is on v2.3-safe. Observability shows stable latency and <1% 5xx. KV cache miss normalized.

Priya: Great. Keep monitoring for 30m. Open action items: 1) Root cause: why did KV cache thrash? 2) Capacity: request quota bump for nova-prod-us1 nodes to avoid autoscaler failures. 3) Postmortem + customer impact calculation for billing adjustments.

Sam (AM): I'll notify Nova with a concise update: mitigation applied, service returned to normal, we have a follow-up postmortem planned.

Maya: On the technical side, we should snapshot the environment and collect heap profiles from affected pods. Jordan, can you capture and upload to the incident artifacts bucket?

Jordan: Capturing heap profiles and logs now. Uploading to s3://incidents/nova/1719000123/

incident-bot: Artifact upload complete: s3://incidents/nova/1719000123/profiles.tgz (size 38MB)

Priya: Assigning postmortem to Oncall-SRE and Jordan. Include timeline, mitigation decisions, and a matrix of override rules tested. Also include recommended conservative routing policy for dedicated tenants with strict SLAs.

Oncall-SRE: Taking postmortem ownership. Will start draft and ping infra for quota request.

Sam (AM): I'll coordinate the customer follow-up and share the draft.

Maya: Closing thought — consider automating a "safe-variant auto-pin" when we detect sustained OOM+eviction patterns on a tenant's dedicated pool. Could prevent noisy failovers.

Priya: Noted. We'll open an RFC after the postmortem. For now, keep this thread for updates. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Final note: rollback command tested and verified earlier in staging. If we need to revert: `routectl rollback --tenant nova --to-default`

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> MONITORING. Duration: 00:21:10.

Priya: Marking as resolved in pagerduty. I'll set a follow-up meeting at 09:00 UTC to review artifacts.

Sam (AM): Thanks team. I'll send customer note after your 30m confirmation.

Maya: 30m check: metrics still good. Leaving notes for postmortem.

Oncall-SRE: Postmortem draft started: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/NOVA-1719000123 (WIP)

Priya: excellent. Closing thread in 2h if no regressions.
